svg.title: PostgreSQL: a typed message
svg.desc: The typed message of frame 12 of psql-login.pcap, 32 bits per row: the type byte p, a length of 54 that counts itself and the body but not the type byte, then the body, the mechanism name SCRAM-SHA-256 ended by a null byte, the length 32 of the initial response and the SCRAM client-first-message; PostgreSqlMessage keeps the named type, the length, the body bytes and a Raw body.
